top_30_curriculum_gaps.gap: Basic negation/short-answer system is not a taught grammar point in the path

top_30_curriculum_gaps.proposed_solution: Add be/do negation with affirmative/negative/question variants

top_30_curriculum_gaps.gap: Core particle progression is not explicit in lessons
top_30_curriculum_gaps.why_it_matters: に/へ/で and から/まで are essential for travel and time
top_30_curriculum_gaps.proposed_solution: Teach particles through route and appointment tasks

top_30_curriculum_gaps.gap: 72/73 grammar points have only one curated example
top_30_curriculum_gaps.why_it_matters: A single form cannot show polarity, question, tense or usage conditions
top_30_curriculum_gaps.proposed_solution: Prioritize 35 core grammar points at 6–10 examples

top_30_curriculum_gaps.gap: 82/82 grammar points have only one curated example
top_30_curriculum_gaps.why_it_matters: Japanese needs form, politeness, register and particle variation

minimum.rationale: Close P0 path breaks: foundational grammar, clinic/appointment/restaurant/counters, and multi-turn interaction.

recommended.rationale: A coherent V1: cover the eight proposed daily-life task families, deepen core grammar to a differentiated 6–10 examples, and add interaction chains without forcing all library items into lessons.

extended.rationale: Future depth: workplace, driving, banking, accommodation and advanced discourse variants after V1 validation.

Vocabulary.boundary: Canonical lemma, sense, reading/POS, stage and collisions must be human-approved; dynamic AI is not canonical.

Grammar.boundary: Scope, formula, contrast, level and progression require editorial ownership.

Curated_Examples.boundary: Validate naturalness, form targeting, polarity/question/register coverage and vocabulary difficulty before insertion.

Expressions.strategy: Derived from existing canonical items first; otherwise AI-assisted + review
Expressions.boundary: Each core expression needs a communicative function and vocabulary/grammar linkage.

Dialogues.strategy: Editorial task design + AI-assisted drafting + native review
Dialogues.boundary: Require role, context, 3–5 turn goal progression, repair/follow-up and register checks.

Dynamic_AI_Examples.boundary: Ephemeral expansion layer; never counted as curated coverage and never written to curriculum.
